dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Fairy tales... Fairy tales... Nothing but fairy tales...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: Too thin... Too thick... This cover's too hard... This one doesn't even have a cover...

dialogues.speaker: Lohen
dialogues.text: *sigh* So many books full of fairy tales, yet not a single one that would make a half-decent pillow. If only those authors had knuckled down a bit harder, I might have some better options here.
